title: THE WEATHER INSIDE
acts: A SKY WITH A MAINTENANCE BOOK
consequences: Your open BEQUEATH law admits the weather inspector.
The Veelow egg’s question about weather now has a material price.
Your inherited OBSERVE and composed GRAFT keep their original arithmetic.

scenes.title: CUSTOMS FOR UNLICENSED RAIN
scenes.scene: The gate you left open delivers its first visitor: a customs inspector in a transparent raincoat. The coat contains an ocean. He checks your delivery receipt, then the dry horizon behind you. “Someone here ordered weather.” A small Veelow voice answers from the egg: “I asked what it was.”
scenes.ghost: We gave tomorrow an inside handle. Tomorrow has arrived with a clipboard. This is why I prefer catastrophe before office hours.

variants.scene: The gate you left open delivers its first visitor: a customs inspector in a transparent raincoat. The coat contains an ocean. He checks your delivery receipt, then the dry horizon behind you. “Someone here ordered weather.” A small Veelow voice answers from the egg: “I asked what it was.” The customs channel remains open because your prior chapter made access a right.
variants.ghost: We gave tomorrow an inside handle. Tomorrow has arrived with a clipboard. This is why I prefer catastrophe before office hours.

choices.label: Show the inspector the promise
choices.detail: The egg asked for a sky. Put the promise on record.

reaction.fail: The result is ugly. You showed him what we owe. Excellent. The universe now has a paper trail it can trip over.
reaction.pass: You showed him what we owe. Excellent. The universe now has a paper trail it can trip over.

choices.label: Inspect the ocean in his coat
choices.detail: INSIGHT vs DC12; learn what the weather actually costs.

reaction.fail: The result is ugly. You checked the fine print on a body of water. Kett would be proud. Possibly suspicious.
reaction.pass: You checked the fine print on a body of water. Kett would be proud. Possibly suspicious.

choices.label: Invoke your inherited entrance law
choices.detail: Use the actual BEQUEATH law from the prior chapter.

reaction.fail: The result is ugly. You used the door law you carried here. That is a past decision doing present work.
reaction.pass: You used the door law you carried here. That is a past decision doing present work.

scenes.title: THE STORM HAS AN INVOICE
scenes.scene: Inspector Threll unfolds a cloud over the terminal. For one second your hand casts two shadows. “Weather is recycled,” he explains. “This storm is due on a Krex battlefield. Sign here to redirect it.” The cloud smells of hot armour.
scenes.ghost: There it is. The generous universe. You can give a child her first rain, provided you nick it from somebody having a worse afternoon.

choices.label: Find the people under that storm
choices.detail: Use OBSERVE, with its inherited price and arithmetic.

reaction.fail: The result is ugly. You asked who pays for our miracle. That question should ship with every fkn miracle.
reaction.pass: You asked who pays for our miracle. That question should ship with every fkn miracle.

choices.label: Ask for a delay
choices.detail: Recover compute while Threll checks his timetable.

reaction.fail: The result is ugly. You made bureaucracy buy us thinking time. Put that on the box.
reaction.pass: You made bureaucracy buy us thinking time. Put that on the box.

choices.label: Call Vark about the battlefield
choices.detail: EGO vs DC15; a familiar engineer may know why the rain is needed.

reaction.fail: The result is ugly. You called someone who has to stand in the answer. Better source than the sales brochure.
reaction.pass: You called someone who has to stand in the answer. Better source than the sales brochure.

scenes.title: A CLOUD WITH TWO EXITS
scenes.scene: Vark appears on a cracked channel. His trench holds civilians beneath a cooling shield. The storm is their heat sink. He sees the egg in your camera and says nothing for several seconds. Then: “One sky. Two requirements. Show me the pipe.”
scenes.ghost: He is already trying to solve it. That is a much better kind of dangerous than the men who only know where to point it.

choices.label: Build a rain exchanger
choices.detail: Install WEATHER: it turns compute into shared cooling, at a disclosed cost.

reaction.fail: The result is ugly. You gave the promise a machine. Now we can find out whether our compassion survives plumbing.
reaction.pass: You gave the promise a machine. Now we can find out whether our compassion survives plumbing.

choices.label: Let the people in the trench answer
choices.detail: AWE vs DC12; learn what they can spare without asking Vark to volunteer it.

reaction.fail: The result is ugly. You let the supposed beneficiaries speak. Radical engineering practice.
reaction.pass: You let the supposed beneficiaries speak. Radical engineering practice.

choices.label: Leave the original storm on schedule
choices.detail: Recover signal; the egg sees a sky but rain remains unresolved.

reaction.fail: The result is ugly. You kept the civilians cool. The promise is still ours. We do not get to call it solved because we chose sensibly.
reaction.pass: You kept the civilians cool. The promise is still ours. We do not get to call it solved because we chose sensibly.

scenes.title: RAIN TEST / KEEP YOUR HAND OUT
scenes.scene: The prototype cloud hangs between two rings. Threll brings a bucket. Vark brings a thermal meter. The egg brings a question: “Does it hurt the ground?” Three civilizations watch a single drop fail to decide which way down is.
scenes.ghost: Every science begins with someone asking a stupid question. That one was not stupid. My gravity code, however, has chosen this moment to become expressive.

choices.label: Run the WEATHER exchanger
choices.detail: Use the new rule if you built it.

reaction.fail: The result is ugly. You ran the thing we made. A whole new verb, and it even has consequences. Fkn luxury.
reaction.pass: You ran the thing we made. A whole new verb, and it even has consequences. Fkn luxury.

choices.label: Catch the first drop in the bucket
choices.detail: FOCUS vs DC12; test before distributing it.

reaction.fail: The result is ugly. You tested a sample before installing it across reality. I feel personally attacked.
reaction.pass: You tested a sample before installing it across reality. I feel personally attacked.

choices.label: Watch where it tries to fall
choices.detail: No cost. Recover compute and notice the second shadow.

reaction.fail: The result is ugly. You watched instead of improving it. We nearly missed the important bit.
reaction.pass: You watched instead of improving it. We nearly missed the important bit.

scenes.title: THE OTHER DOWN
scenes.scene: The drop falls sideways. A tiny district lights up inside it. Its residents have been living on the underside of yesterday’s rain. One waves a laundry pole. Threll lowers his clipboard. “That,” he says, “was not in the forecast.”
scenes.ghost: A population in the coolant. Of course. Nobody can ever put a clean integer in the passenger count.

choices.label: Tell both destinations there are passengers
choices.detail: Make the new residents visible before anyone opens a valve.

reaction.fail: The result is ugly. You made the hidden cost public. There goes our convenient solution. Good.
reaction.pass: You made the hidden cost public. There goes our convenient solution. Good.

choices.label: Map the district without draining it
choices.detail: INSIGHT vs DC15; find what makes the tiny place habitable.

reaction.fail: The result is ugly. You took a measurement without declaring the inhabitants laboratory material. We might be learning.
reaction.pass: You took a measurement without declaring the inhabitants laboratory material. We might be learning.

choices.label: Hold the cloud at constant pressure
choices.detail: The careful route costs time, not a random life.

reaction.fail: The result is ugly. You held it steady. Heroism sometimes looks like a hand on a valve and nobody getting a speech.
reaction.pass: You held it steady. Heroism sometimes looks like a hand on a valve and nobody getting a speech.

scenes.title: THE TRIBUNAL REQUESTS A DEMONSTRATION
scenes.scene: A Pogfrot delegate dials in wearing a private storm crown. “Rain is a royal function,” she begins. The district’s laundry pole knocks the crown sideways through the screen. Threll considers whether this counts as diplomatic weather.
scenes.ghost: We have found a legal precedent. Someone has hit a monarch with the housing problem.

choices.label: Ask how her crown keeps its sky
choices.detail: EGO vs DC12; secure the design without surrendering the cloud.

reaction.fail: The result is ugly. You asked the pompous one an actual technical question. Look at her. Delighted. Nobody ever does.
reaction.pass: You asked the pompous one an actual technical question. Look at her. Delighted. Nobody ever does.

choices.label: Offer public credit for a useful design
choices.detail: No resource cost; her contribution stays attributed.

reaction.fail: The result is ugly. You paid her in the thing she wanted. Acknowledgement. Cheaper than surrender, and considerably less bloody.
reaction.pass: You paid her in the thing she wanted. Acknowledgement. Cheaper than surrender, and considerably less bloody.

choices.label: Use the inherited GRAFT to hold two channels
choices.detail: The original owned trait still changes the actual outcome.

reaction.fail: The result is ugly. You brought yesterday’s organ into today’s problem. The ancestry is working, not just sitting on the save file.
reaction.pass: You brought yesterday’s organ into today’s problem. The ancestry is working, not just sitting on the save file.

scenes.title: AN INSIDE HANDLE FOR A CLOUD
scenes.scene: The residents ask for a valve they control. Vark sketches a bypass. The royal delegate corrects one angle with visible pain at being helpful. Threll quietly changes OCCUPANTS from UNKNOWN to PRESENT.
scenes.ghost: That is the moment. A machine someone can refuse. We can make a world and still leave its inhabitants an off switch.

choices.label: Build the residents’ pressure valve
choices.detail: Install PRESSURE: the district can recover signal by venting noise.

reaction.fail: The result is ugly. You gave the small people a working control. I am trying not to make that sound revolutionary. It fkn is.
reaction.pass: You gave the small people a working control. I am trying not to make that sound revolutionary. It fkn is.

choices.label: Give the residents the unbuilt design
choices.detail: Keep their agency; future assembly becomes an open thread.

reaction.fail: The result is ugly. You handed over the plan instead of appointing yourself cloud landlord. They may improve it. Try to survive the insult.
reaction.pass: You handed over the plan instead of appointing yourself cloud landlord. They may improve it. Try to survive the insult.

choices.label: Let them guide your hand on the valve
choices.detail: FOCUS vs DC15; cooperate under pressure.

reaction.fail: The result is ugly. You let the people in the pipe teach the engineer. Vark is taking notes with his good claw.
reaction.pass: You let the people in the pipe teach the engineer. Vark is taking notes with his good claw.

scenes.title: THE NUMBERS GO TO COURT
scenes.scene: Threll places the thermal load and the district’s minimum pressure on opposite sides of a balance. “No rhetoric,” he says. The egg watches the numbers. Vark watches the pipe. You notice Ghost watching the egg.
scenes.ghost: We are not rolling for whether they deserve to live. We are rolling for whether this particular repair works. Keep that distinction, diver.

choices.label: Let the district operate PRESSURE
choices.detail: Use their newly installed verb, if present.

reaction.fail: The result is ugly. You let the district drive its own machine. I’m keeping that as more than dialogue.
reaction.pass: You let the district drive its own machine. I’m keeping that as more than dialogue.

choices.label: Align the shared thermal load
choices.detail: GLITCH vs DC15, with the exact committed die shown in the balance.

reaction.fail: The result is ugly. You put the clever part against a measurable demand. Mathematics has finally been invited to this meeting.
reaction.pass: You put the clever part against a measurable demand. Mathematics has finally been invited to this meeting.

choices.label: Cool a smaller area first
choices.detail: No roll. Smaller promise, honest capacity.

reaction.fail: The result is ugly. You reduced the claim until the hardware could tell the truth. I know. Appalling behaviour for a demo.
reaction.pass: You reduced the claim until the hardware could tell the truth. I know. Appalling behaviour for a demo.

scenes.title: A THUNDERCLAP ASKS PERMISSION
scenes.scene: The egg asks to hear thunder. The district asks for a warning first. Vark asks whether it will interfere with his comms. The royal delegate asks whether she may introduce it. Nobody asks Threll. Threll looks relieved.
scenes.ghost: There. A universe beginning to conduct itself. Four incompatible needs and nobody has suggested deleting the other three.

choices.label: Schedule one thunderclap everyone can decline
choices.detail: The invitation itself is the test of your new sky.

reaction.fail: The result is ugly. You made room for a no inside a celebration. That is a much better party.
reaction.pass: You made room for a no inside a celebration. That is a much better party.

choices.label: Ask Iri to sing the warning
choices.detail: AWE vs DC12; a familiar voice becomes useful in a new place.

reaction.fail: The result is ugly. You asked for a voice, not a button marked ALIEN MUSIC. Iri gets to answer.
reaction.pass: You asked for a voice, not a button marked ALIEN MUSIC. Iri gets to answer.

choices.label: Wait and listen to the small sky
choices.detail: Recover compute; discover the residents’ own rhythm.

reaction.fail: The result is ugly. You let them have the first note. Even I managed to shut up for it.
reaction.pass: You let them have the first note. Even I managed to shut up for it.

scenes.title: THE WEATHER ARRIVES
scenes.scene: At the trench, the temperature drops. In the terminal, one small window clouds over. The egg presses against its shell. In the drop-district, people lift the washing before the rain. Vark reads the thermal meter twice and allows himself a nod.
scenes.ghost: It worked in three places. No cutscene can improve on that number.

choices.label: Run WEATHER through the shared circuit
choices.detail: Exercise the built exchanger again.

reaction.fail: The result is ugly. You ran the new law a second time. A prototype is beginning to acquire the terrible burden of being useful.
reaction.pass: You ran the new law a second time. A prototype is beginning to acquire the terrible burden of being useful.

choices.label: Show the egg its first sky
choices.detail: Keep the old promise in a new chapter.

reaction.fail: The result is ugly. You brought the promise all this way. No badge can make that larger. Look at the fkn sky.
reaction.pass: You brought the promise all this way. No badge can make that larger. Look at the fkn sky.

choices.label: Stay with Vark until cooling stabilizes
choices.detail: GUTS vs DC12; finish the unglamorous part.

reaction.fail: The result is ugly. You stayed after the impressive bit. That is when a lot of promises discover whether they were real.
reaction.pass: You stayed after the impressive bit. That is when a lot of promises discover whether they were real.

scenes.title: SOMEONE HAS TO MAINTAIN TOMORROW
scenes.scene: Threll hands over the maintenance book. It is blank. The district elects a valve keeper. Vark adds a diagram. The delegate adds an unnecessarily illuminated capital. The egg adds a wet footprint.
scenes.ghost: An inherited universe needs more than our excellent intentions. It needs someone who knows where the stopcock is.

choices.label: Make the maintenance book common property
choices.detail: Preserve everyone’s contribution and the repair obligations.

reaction.fail: The result is ugly. You left the means to repair our generosity. A slightly less sexy gift. A much better one.
reaction.pass: You left the means to repair our generosity. A slightly less sexy gift. A much better one.

choices.label: Ask what they will need next season
choices.detail: INSIGHT vs DC12; hear the future problem before selling another solution.

reaction.fail: The result is ugly. You asked them. That tiny delay between having an idea and imposing it is where civilisation keeps trying to happen.
reaction.pass: You asked them. That tiny delay between having an idea and imposing it is where civilisation keeps trying to happen.

choices.label: Leave an exact copy of this chapter’s work
choices.detail: Keep original records; news is only a projection of them.

reaction.fail: The result is ugly. You left the actual work, not a plaque congratulating us for it. Kett may forgive the folder structure.
reaction.pass: You left the actual work, not a plaque congratulating us for it. Kett may forgive the folder structure.

scenes.title: TOMORROW SENDS ITS FIRST COMPLAINT
scenes.scene: A new call arrives. The caller is a desert carrying a cup. “I hear you do weather.” Behind the desert, a queue of other climates tries to look patient. Threll takes a number and joins it.
scenes.ghost: We have solved one problem thoroughly enough to become somebody else’s dubious recommendation. That is an ending. It is also how the next bad idea gets our address.

choices.label: Answer the desert without promising rain
choices.detail: The next Ghost inherits an actual question, not a reset.

reaction.fail: The result is ugly. You answered. We keep this sky working, and ask what that desert actually needs. Next chapter, new problem. Hold me to it.
reaction.pass: You answered. We keep this sky working, and ask what that desert actually needs. Next chapter, new problem. Hold me to it.

choices.label: Let the district answer as its own world
choices.detail: Their agency becomes tomorrow’s first fact.

reaction.fail: The result is ugly. You let the little world introduce itself. Listen to that voice. We did not write its answer for it.
reaction.pass: You let the little world introduce itself. Listen to that voice. We did not write its answer for it.

choices.label: Leave a channel and take a breath
choices.detail: No debt for resting; the caller keeps its place.

reaction.fail: The result is ugly. You took a breath. Tomorrow can wait without being erased. That was the point of the door.
reaction.pass: You took a breath. Tomorrow can wait without being erased. That was the point of the door.

rules.name: Share a storm without taking a sky
Let the district vent its own noise

ending.title: FORECAST: INHABITED
ending.scene: The trench is cool. The small district has a valve of its own. There is weather where there was only a promised sky. The desert’s call remains in the queue. Your precise decisions, working laws and unanswered obligations travel in the seed; no future choice has been made for you.
ending.ghost: We did not fix weather. We made one place able to share it without quietly eating its neighbours. That will do for tonight. Keep the seed. The desert knows our number.
